title: citharexylum fruticosum var. villosum
intro: Citharexylum fruticosum var. villosum, commonly known as Silver Mist, is a plant species belonging to the Verbenaceae family. It is native to Mexico and is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Citharexylum fruticosum var. villosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
